steps.caption: Open Ask AI from the sidebar.
Press the paper-clip to attach a file: PDF, Word, TXT, CSV or MD, up to 15 MB.
The lease PDF is attached (× removes it).
Ask it to extract the lease terms.
A table of terms: value, page number, the exact quote and a check mark.
Area, rent and dates are parsed by code from the quote — not invented by the AI.
'verified on page' means the quote really is on that page.
Terms not in the document stay 'unknown' — e.g. CAM and fit-out.
Now attach the terms to a lease record. Search by tenant name.
Pick Zentrix's lease at Kharadi Tech Park.
Tick to also store the PDF on the lease.
Press Attach to lease record. Nothing is saved yet.
An approval card shows every field: what it is now, what it would become, and the page it came from.
Here the area changes from 18,000 to 18,500 sq ft (page 1).
Approve change. Material lease fields go on to Review for a second check.
Done — the proposal now waits in Review.
